title: Shinonome Ena — Peaceful Moments, If Nothing Else〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, this isn't the color I wanted...
I think I dropped the saturation too much...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But this sort of tone actually kinda works, so it could be feeling off because...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, how am I supposed to after hearing all that...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I did...
But she must've found it while looking around inside my computer when I was out...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have to think that she also found my lyrics and Nightcord...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<So...
She asked me to stop working on music with Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Rummaging through someone's computer is already a violation of their privacy, but forcing her to quit our group on top of that is so...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We probably wouldn't have known either if Mafuyu hadn't said anything.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Her not knowing might've actually been better but at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's take your mom out of the equation for a second, Mafuyu. What do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I want to make music with all of you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, as a fellow member of N25, I'll do what I can to help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu said that she doesn't want to give up music...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I can't do anything to help her...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: As frustrating as this situation is, there's no real point in me dwelling on it. For now, I should just keep working and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! It's four in the morning already...?! Oh, Kanade even sent me a message...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <I need to rest my eyes for a bit.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That was fifteen minutes ago... She's probably asleep now, but Mizuki's awake.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<N-No... It isn't...
What Yuki and K said is really bothering me...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah... Actually, me too...
I haven't been able to focus at all after hearing that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You too, Amia? I guess it's only natural, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
Maybe drawing something else will help clear my mind. Where'd I put my sketchbook...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I only have a few pages left...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(And I'm running low on supplies...
It might be a good time to restock. Actually, in that case...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Um, Amia?
Wanna go shopping with me later today?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? Wait, you just want me to carry stuff for you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, that's not it! I need to buy a new sketchbook and restock on art supplies...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But going alone would be pretty boring, so why don't we chat about stuff while we shop?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I guess you're right...
Having someone there would be better.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, let's meet at the station a little past noon.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, wanna check out some shops that I've been meaning to go to?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, sounds good. It'll be a nice breath of fresh air.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Awesome!
Alright, let's do a ton of stuff together♪>
